{{Quote|It's beautiful. A pristine natural world covered with forests and jungles, rivers and waterfalls.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Dark Apprentice (novel)">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>}}
'''Ithor''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. One of the oldest members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was a planet full of lush life, and the planet's surface had not a touch of civilization on it. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] themselves, otherwise known as "Hammerheads," built great floating cities that did not harm the surface, which they considered to be sacred. Entry upon the surface was forbidden, unless one stayed there permanently. Some Ithorians such as the [[The Oracle (Ithorian)|Oracle]] were compelled to go down to the planet surface, however, as they "heard the call" of [[Mother Jungle/Legends|Mother Jungle]], the [[Ithorian religion]]'s personification of Ithor's world-spanning jungle. The surface of the planet of Ithor played host to numerous plants, including the [[bafforr tree]], which possessed telepathic capabilities. The planet contained [[andurite]] stone, and every three Ithorian years was the center of the [[Herd Meet/Legends|Time of Meeting]]. The planet had many moons in its night sky.

==History==
===Historical background===
[[File:Ithorian-NEGAS.png|thumb|left|220px|An [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]]]
Ithor joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to [[8000 BBY]]. In [[3963 BBY]], when Republic fleet [[Incident near Ithor system|encountered]] a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] raiding force in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field|field]] near [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]], [[Dace Golliard]] predicted they would attack Ithor next, although it turned out to be a ruse set up by [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Cassus Fett]] to capture Golliard. In [[439 BBY]], scientists attempted to bond the telepathic capabilities of the bafforr tree with another, more vicious tree on the planet surface. The result was a new parasitic life form named "[[Spore]]," but its parasitic hostility forced the Ithorians to lock it away in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]]. It was long afterwards discovered by miners.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Spore">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Spore]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
As in previous millennia, Ithor remained loyal to the Galactic Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The vast and well-protected natural resources of the forest world were never compromised by Separatist attacks. A number of small attacks and probing actions were attempted against Ithor by the Confederacy early in the war, but these were determined to be little more than diversions as the Separatists launched full-scale [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|invasions]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and other important Republic targets.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> A [[attack against Ithorian terrorists]] was carried out by the Jedi<ref name="R58">[[Republic 58|''Republic'' 58]]</ref> on Ithor.<ref name="CSWEEO">{{CSWECite|I|243|Evan-Ott}}</ref> During the Clone Wars, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was reported dead in an [[Incident on Ithor|incident]] on Ithor.

===Imperial and New Republic Eras===
Sometime before the Battle of Yavin, Ithor came [[Subjugation of Ithor|under siege]] by the Galactic Empire, which demanded access to Ithorian agricultural techniques and technology in an attempt to locate biotech for military applications. Lead by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alima]] he threatened the Ithorians with the destruction of their sentient forests, the [[Cathor Hills]]. However the Empire was [[Battle of Ithor (0 ABY)|ousted]] from the planet through a deal formulated by [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]], where he bargained with the Empire to reveal the secrets of the Ithorians' technology and agricultural ceremonies, in return for the protection of their 'mother jungle'.<ref name="The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Galactic Empire planned to [[Skirmish at Ithor|attack]] the planet. The Rebel Alliance heard of these plans prior to the attack and dispatched [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to rescue a group of Ithorians wishing to evacuate. Just a few minutes before the attack, Han and his co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were able to rescue the Ithorians. A small battle raged afterwards, with many TIE Fighters. Han and Chewbacca managed to dodge [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] in a nearby asteroid field and place the Ithorians on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]].<ref name="Han Solo's Rescue Mission">''[[Han Solo's Rescue Mission]]''</ref>

[[Umwaw Moolis]] represented the planet in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="Children of the Jedi novel">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

===Destruction===
However, by [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Ithor's tranquil existence came to an end. The [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] blazed a trail from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and Ithor lay directly in their path. Retreating from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]], the New Republic made a [[Battle of Ithor|stand]] at the planet, hoping to resist the invasion long enough to make use of the bafforr tree pollen, which had somehow reacted violently with the living armor of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The battle entered into a state of stalemate, until [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] dueled [[Shedao Shai]], the leader of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces, with the planet Ithor at stake. Though Horn was victorious, Shai's subordinate, [[Deign Lian]], was ordered by [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] to unleash a plague of toxins upon the planet, in order to eliminate any chance of a [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|pollen-based bioweapon]]. The virulent biochemicals (a biological gray goo) rapidly turned Ithor's verdant forests and animal life into a black ooze which spread and destroyed everything it touched.<ref name="Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>
In retaliation, the assembled [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Remnant]] and New Republic forces fired massive barrages of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and proton torpedoes at the Yuuzhan Vong command ship, ''[[Legacy of Torment]]'', which broke into three sections. The rear end of the massive warship tumbled into the now [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]]-[[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] rich atmosphere and ignited it, turning Ithor into a firestorm ridden inferno of a planet.<ref name="Dark Tide II: Ruin" />

===Ithor's legacy===
As of [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], when the [[Dark Nest Crisis]] began and ended, the Ithorians were attempting to relocate to [[Borao]]. This attempt almost failed due to the presence of the [[RePlanetHab]] organization, who claimed the rights for the world. [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] was able to block RePlanetHab's attempts at the "suggestion" of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. By the end of the [[Swarm War]] in [[36 ABY]], some scientists were residing on the planet, studying it in hopes of rehabilitation, but most Ithorians settled on [[Borao]] along with [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Öetrago/Legends|Öetrago]] and [[Upell]].<ref name="TEA" />

However, considering the Ithorians' skills in ecology and their previous experience in re-terraforming worlds such as [[Telos IV]], they hoped that Ithor could have been reinhabited one day. Abandoning the [[Ossus Project]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]], the Ithorians decided to rebuild their world using the same technology as during the Restoration of Telos IV. By [[137 ABY]] much of the planet's surface remained rocky and dry, but genetically engineered dangerous plants and animals began to slowly transform the planet's soil and atmosphere into livable state. Visitors to the planet surface were still required to wear [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] to avoid a large number of toxins in the atmosphere, but [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]] were no longer necessary.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Biosphere==
[[File:IthorNEGAS.jpg|thumb|250px|Ithor before the destruction]]
The surface of the planet Ithor was formerly an immense jungle. Following the Ithorian belief in the [[Law of Life]], most Ithorians never actually set foot on their own planet, instead they lived in floating cities above their world called herdships. Only three of their continents had been explored and harvested, the other two never having been touched by Ithorian hands, demonstrating their devout belief in the protection and sustainability of their environment.

Such protectionism toward their environment gave rise to numerous native plants and animals.

The [[bafforr tree]] was considered semi-sentient and possessed telepathic capabilities and acted as a sort of distributed intellect - the larger the forest was, the higher the collective intellect.
